![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14095706/assets/3149b7dadc839e4155835c7cd0e9120a861dd79c698831e65b444a79d1ac7016.png)

The polar equation of the curve shown above is $r=${{field-1}}.
feedback.worked_solution:
Notice that the given curve is a circle of radius $\frac{19}{3}$ centered at the origin.

Therefore, its polar equation is $r=\frac{19}{3}.$
